title: Build batch import decoding and patch mapping
description: Build the non-CLI batch import service using the JSON/CSV codecs and provider batch transaction. Read from a named file or stdin, infer format from .csv/.json, require --format-equivalent input for stdin or unknown extensions, and let an explicit valid format override the extension. Convert decoded rows into provider requests without losing three-state patch semantics: JSON omission and CSV blank preserve, JSON null and CSV _clear explicitly clear, and supplied nonblank values update. Parse configured statuses and priority/estimate enums consistently with single-task update, pass dependency identifiers through for provider-wide resolution, and require every row's updatedAt concurrency token. Collect deterministic row/task/field diagnostics for all independent parse and mapping errors before calling the provider; never invoke mutation when decoding or mapping fails. Return the provider updated/unchanged TaskViews in input order and do not print or own CLI flags. Add tests for both formats, stdin, inference and overrides, clear mapping, enum/status errors, malformed paths, aggregate diagnostics, and proof that invalid input never calls the provider.

comments.author: codex-wtp-loop
comments.message: Design milestone: implementing internal/batchimport as a CLI-independent service parallel to batchexport. It will resolve file/stdin formats, decode via batchjson/batchcsv, preserve codec patch presence and clear semantics, aggregate deterministic catalog/enum mapping diagnostics before one provider BatchUpdate call, and return the provider result unchanged.

comments.message: Implementation complete: added internal/batchimport service with file/stdin reads, extension inference and explicit format overrides, codec-backed JSON/CSV patch preservation, configured status plus priority/estimate normalization, deterministic aggregate mapping diagnostics, provider BatchUpdate-only-after-validation, and input-order result sorting. JSON/CSV decoders now aggregate independent row errors. Added focused coverage for formats/stdin/overrides, clear semantics, enums/statuses, malformed paths, diagnostics, provider-call suppression, and result ordering. Verification passed: go test ./internal/batchjson ./internal/batchcsv ./internal/batchimport; go test ./...; go vet ./...; git diff --check.
